name: silk-math-preview
description: Live math preview that follows your caret. Inline LaTeX, Markdown, Jupyter, and MathJax equations with no compile step. 光标走到哪，公式就在哪渲染。

silkMath.enabled.description: 光标位于公式中时显示实时预览。Show a live preview while the caret is inside a formula.

silkMath.debounceMs.description: 合并连续输入的等待时间（毫秒）。Debounce delay for consecutive edits, in milliseconds.

enumDescriptions: 在当前公式下方悬浮显示。Float below the active formula.
在当前公式上方悬浮显示。Float above the active formula.
silkMath.previewPosition.description: 预览以不改变源码行高的浮层显示在公式下方或上方；旧 after/before 设置会自动迁移。Float below or above without changing source line height; legacy after/before values migrate automatically.

silkMath.enableInLatex.description: 在 LaTeX / TeX 文件中启用实时预览。Enable the live preview in LaTeX/TeX files.

silkMath.enableInMarkdown.description: 在 Markdown / MDX 文件中启用实时预览。Enable the live preview in Markdown/MDX files.

silkMath.enableInOtherFiles.description: 在其他所有文件类型中按 LaTeX 语法识别公式。Recognize math with LaTeX syntax in every other file type.

silkMath.previewScale.description: 预览相对编辑器字号的缩放。默认 1.35（界面显示为 100%）。Preview scale relative to the editor font; default 1.35 is shown as 100%.

silkMath.trace.description: 把每次渲染的表达式、尺寸与错误写入“Silk Math”输出面板，便于反馈问题。Log each render to the Silk Math output channel for troubleshooting.

silkMath.markUnknownCommands.description: 把未定义的命令按红色原文显示出来，而不是让整条公式渲染失败。Render undefined commands as red text instead of failing the whole formula.

silkMath.showRenderErrors.description: 公式始终无法渲染时在浮层里显示原因，而不是什么都不显示。Show the reason in the floating panel when a formula never renders, instead of showing nothing.

silkMath.previewDefinitions.description: 仅含 \def / \newcommand / \renewcommand 的公式默认不预览。打开后会把刚定义的命令展开画出来。Skip definition-only formulas by default; when enabled, render a sample of each newly defined command.

silkMath.showCaret.description: 在渲染公式中显示与源码同步的细光标。Show the source-synchronized caret in rendered math.

silkMath.maxFormulaChars.description: 单个公式允许预览的最大字符数。Maximum previewable characters per formula.

silkMath.rendererIdleMs.description: 无预览请求后释放渲染 Worker 的等待时间。Delay before releasing an idle render Worker.

silkMath.customMathEnvironments.description: 额外明确视为数学模式的环境名称。Additional environment names treated as math mode.

silkMath.quickFixOnType.description: 对高置信、无歧义的命令拼写错误显示诊断和显式 Quick Fix；不会静默修改源码。Offer explicit Quick Fixes for high-confidence command typos; source is never changed silently.

silkMath.ocr.enabled.description: 在状态栏菜单中显示按需安装的本地截图公式/文字识别入口。Show the on-demand local screenshot OCR entry in the Silk Math status menu.
